$comment: The standalone CAD emergency update channel, as ONE data file consumed by every layer that
has to agree on it: the release workflow (.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml) publishes the
signed ZIP + manifest under `<bucket>/<prefix>/`, the packager (scripts/package-client.ps1)
interpolates the resulting manifest URL and public-key location into the generated
install.ps1/uninstall.ps1 and ships updater/prodkeys/public.pem inside the client package,
scripts/Test-PackagedBundle.ps1 proves the shipped package carries that key and that the
generated scripts name the contract's URL, and bridge.Tests/UpdateChannelContractTests.cs pins
the workflow, the packager and the release host together so none can drift silently. The channel
is served from the same private MinIO `releases` bucket and the same `updates.<domain>` release
gateway as Desktop releases (aleph-cloud/infra/release-gateway/Caddyfile already allow-lists
/autocad-bridge/*); Cloudflare R2 is no longer used.
The signature public key is separate from Desktop's own Tauri updater key: a Desktop installer
signature says the installer is genuine, this key says a standalone CAD ZIP is a genuine CadAI
release. Private half lives only in the UPDATE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY Actions secret.
